name: serpapi
description: Search web, news, shopping, maps, and more with SerpApi.

interface.longDescription: Search structured results from Google, Bing, YouTube, Amazon, Google Maps, Google Scholar, and other SerpApi engines. Find product listings, local places, academic papers, travel options, news, and source links. Requires a SerpApi account and API key. Use serpapi-setup to configure access through an available MCP connection, CLI, or cURL before searching.
defaultPrompt: Find this week's major AI search news and cite the original sources.
Compare current AirPods Pro listings on Amazon, Walmart, and eBay.
Find well-reviewed coffee shops near Times Square.
